decisions.reason: As a multi-model line close to the core offer with earlier standalone presentation, it carries substantial sunk development effort and public commitment, so management would likely continue it despite limited recent visibility.
Although less visibly promoted, it supports the firm's stated automation direction and can still be justified internally as strategically important and worth further time in a growing market.

This product line remains near the established formwork business and fits the firm's modular technology base, making continued commitment more likely than withdrawal even if it is easier to prune than the flagship launches.
Its earlier dedicated webpage and close fit with the existing formwork portfolio indicate visible commitment and sunk costs that favor retention.

As the least prominently committed single component in a category where the firm has already shown willingness to prune offerings, it is the most plausible candidate to be withdrawn to free resources for stronger core products and new development.
